selection_basis: Target identities fixed before development runs: dopamine transporter, sigma receptor 1 and PI3K alpha broaden target functions. No new-target performance used to select tasks.

promotion_gate.tie_break: Highest mean final discovery gain, then lowest mean final audit MAE, then policy ID. Freeze greedy if no challenger passes.

reliability_gate.meaning: Descriptive screening only, using equal-weight case/round summaries; no target-level significance claim. OOF residual bands have no formal coverage guarantee under adaptive selection or scaffold shift.

primary_metric: Final strongest-decile pool discoveries per 40 picks; threshold evaluator-only after replay
interval_method: Training-only shuffled three-fold out-of-fold absolute residual 80th percentile (higher interpolation), symmetric band around full observed-data fit. Empirical diagnostic, not a conformal guarantee.
